questions.question: Describe the dowry system in India. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the dowry system in India. [CO1]
  • Answer: The dowry system is the practice where the bride’s family gives money or valuables to the groom’s family
  • during marriage. It became a social evil leading to financial burden and harassment of women.
